
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/cunzai/p/19648856" title="发布于 2026-02-27 23:12">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">我用AI写了一个“人生记录器”-第二版</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文介绍了我用 AI 编程工具迭代出的「人生记录器/拾光记忆」第二版：从第一版的周记改为更细致的日记，并加入 GitHub 风格热力图、人生时钟、情绪统计与趋势、往年今日、相册瀑布流、纪念日/计划日、高亮日历、目标清单、最近照片墙以及一键导出 PDF+原图等功能。项目强调私密性，仅管理员邀请注册，适合小圈子使用，并已开源。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>1.发神经</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>最近有点兴奋，倒不是刚过完年，毕竟现在都开工好几天了，小长假早就成为过去式。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>而是我换了新的 AI 编程工具：从最开始的 Cursor，到后来的 Claude Code + 国产模型，再到现在的 gpt5.3-codex。此刻我的感受就是——编程从未如此顺畅，描述之所及，就是程序能到达的地方。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>强烈建议还没体验过 AI 编程的朋友去试一下。我已经连续好几天下了班就沉浸在自己的「Vibe Coding」里了。就我写文档的此时此刻，AI 还在后台努力生产代码，甚至我脑子里已经开始排队新的想法了。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>最近睡眠还有点不足，该补补觉了。</span></p>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>2.总览</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>经过 AI 的“不懈努力”，“人生记录器”迎来了第二代。话不多说，先上图。</span></p>
<div><span><br><img alt="image-20260227213211301" width="810" height="734" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230437125-10981621.png" class="lazyload"><br></span></div>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>（此图中的所有内容都为测试使用的虚假数据，下图同）</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>这就是「拾光记忆」第二版的主界面。为照顾到新朋友，我还是从上到下、从左到右把现有功能简单讲一下。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>看过第一版的朋友应该还有印象：第一版我主打「周记」，以周为单位记录，一年用 52 个方格表示。当时主要觉得大家都很忙，没必要每天写，一周抽一天记录就挺好。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>后来我推翻了这个观点，改成「日记」。周记的缺点还挺明显的： ① 一周里很多天的内容会混在一起，比如这一周情绪比较动荡，很难用一个表情概括； ② 如果只用一天去记录这一周，前几天发生的事可能已经忘了，或者已经没有当时那股劲儿了； ③ 界面比较稀疏，看着也没那么美观。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>而日记就舒服多了：每天抽一点时间写一下；实在没空可以之后补录；那天确实没啥好记的——大不了就空着嘛。</span></p>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>3.个人信息管理</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>个人信息比较简洁，昵称、头像、出生年月、预期寿命（默认就是100岁，祝屏幕前的各位都能长命百岁），外加一个修改密码。</span></p>
<div><img alt="image-20260227214539881" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230610011-871869232.png" class="lazyload"></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<br>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>当然你可能注意到头像旁边还有个小按钮。这里就不得不提我做这个项目的初衷：</span><strong style="color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-radius: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); padding: 0; margin: 0"><span>隐私</span></strong><span>。这个项目主打私密性——仅管理员可邀请注册，适合家庭/情侣/密友圈这种小范围使用。</span></p>
<div><span><span><img alt="image-20260227214750789" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230635018-2144241972.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></div>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>4.人生时钟</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>「出生天数」和「年龄」没啥好说的，就是统计数字。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>「人生时钟」则是把你的人生进度映射到一天的 24 小时里。对于长命百岁的你来说，现在可能还是早上：太阳刚刚升起，一切皆有可能。</span></p>
<div><img alt="image-20260227215311572" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230659131-623009446.png" class="lazyload"></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<br>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>5.日记热力图</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>仿照 GitHub 的贡献热力图做的：一列代表一周，52 周组在一起就是一年。</span></p>
<div><span><span><img alt="image-20260227215821515" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230718152-1543186842.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></div>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>年份可切换，方便回顾往昔岁月。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>图里的格子一共 5 种状态：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><span>浅灰：未填写</span></li>
<li><span>绿：当天有开心的事</span></li>
<li><span>黄：情绪较平稳/没啥波动</span></li>
<li><span>红：很沮丧</span></li>
<li><span>深灰：未来日期（不可填写，毕竟谁也预知不了未来）</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>如果日记上传了图片，会把第一张图作为格子背景。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>当天的格子会用高亮边框包起来，方便快速定位。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>点开当天或过去的格子就能填写内容：支持本地图片上传、粘贴板图片上传、表情。</span></p>
<div><span><span><img alt="image-20260227220353804" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230746202-1164616572.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></div>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>6.人生统计</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>主要是对填写的内容做个汇总：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><span>已记录总天数：所有年份记录的总天数</span></li>
<li><span>累计上传图片量：所有年份上传图片的总数</span></li>
<li><span>最长连续记录：你保持连续记录的最长天数</span></li>
<li><span>本年情绪分布：今年各个情绪的占比</span></li>
<li><span>本年情绪趋势：我想用趋势展示一段时间内的情绪变化。如果每天都记录会很直观；但如果有不少空白日期（像图里这样），趋势会显得有点乱，这块还得继续优化。</span></li>
</ul>
<div><img alt="image-20260227220453940" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230809597-324533635.png" class="lazyload"></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<br>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>7.往年今日</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>展示过去几年同样日期的记录，最多显示五条，点击即可跳转到当时的日记。</span></p>
<div><span><span><img alt="image-20260227221146690" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230825947-1098770879.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>8.相册</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>所有上传的照片会以瀑布流形式呈现：鼠标悬停能看到是那一天的故事，点击即可展示超清大图。</span></p>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>当时把这个功能做出来的时候，我自己还挺震撼的。</span></p>
<div><img alt="image-20260227221522795" width="801" height="400" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230844020-1885683885.png" class="lazyload"></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<br>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>9.纪念日</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>点开后会分成「纪念日」和「计划日」。</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><span>纪念日：每年这一天都会在日历上高亮</span></li>
<li><span>计划日：也会高亮，但只显示当年，之后年份不重复</span></li>
</ul>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><strong style="color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; border-radius: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); padding: 0; margin: 0"><span>给重要的日子，加一点「高光」</span></strong></p>
<div><img alt="image-20260227221647599" width="535" height="414" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230911875-1868255457.png" class="lazyload"></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<br>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>10.导出</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>支持一键导出过去日期的内容，包含：PDF 文档、归档原图、以及填写的日记文字内容。</span></p>
<div><span><span><img alt="image-20260227222021525" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230931113-1810810796.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>11.目标清单</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>可以写一句话提醒自己。</span></p>
<div><span><span><img alt="image-20260227222216865" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227230951166-288038571.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>12.最近照片墙</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>偏装饰作用：展示最近九张照片组成九宫格。点击图片可看大图，点「查看全部」也能跳转到相册。</span></p>
<div><img alt="image-20260227222438138" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227231115737-1904561109.png" class="lazyload"></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<br>
<h2 style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: flex; padding: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="font-size: 22px; color: rgba(53, 179, 120, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; font-weight: bold; display: block"><span>13.日历</span></span></h2>
<p style="color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; padding: 8px 0; margin: 0" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span>看看日子，高亮标记纪念日和计划日，并以不同的颜色进行区分，点击即可放大。</span></p>
<div><span><span><img alt="image-20260227222543852" width="484" height="389" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2880894/202602/2880894-20260227231135181-451565322.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></div>
